para.label: Endowment note
para.as_written: هذا النبويات وقف على طور سينا ما لا سلطان من الله يخرجها عنها عنها ومن اخرجها يكون محرم من فم الله و ملايكته
translation: This prophetologion is an endowment for [the monastery of] Mount Sinai, and no one has authority from God to take it out from there. Whoever takes it out, may he be deprived of [the words of] the mouth of God and his angels

location.repository: St. Catherine's Monastery of the Sinai

note.value: The quire signature is marked in the bottom margin of recto of the first folio; a later hand added quires signatures at the wrong place; quires of 8 ff. with the exception of quire XIX (6 ff.) which seems to be complete
Flyleaves (ff. 148–150) from a CPA manuscript (trimmed bifolium). No other part of the same CPA codex is known. Hymn in honour of the apostles Peter and Paul (fragment)
